subject: API key not working after rotation
body: Hi, I rotated my API key yesterday via the console and now every call I make returns 401 Unauthorized. I've checked that AURORA_API_KEY is set correctly and the value matches what's shown in the console. Can you help?

subject: Cannot install Aurora Desktop on macOS
body: I downloaded AuroraDesktop.dmg and dragged the app into Applications, but when I try to launch it I get 'Aurora Desktop is damaged and cannot be opened'. macOS 13.2. What's the right fix?

subject: Compute job killed with oom_killed
body: My training job (jid: 0x4a3f) died after about 90 minutes with status oom_killed. The instance was a gpu-a100 with 16GB RAM. I was hoping to train a 7B model. Should I move to a larger instance?

subject: Where do I see my bill?
body: I've been using the platform for the past 2 weeks but I can't find my current usage anywhere in the console. I see a 'Billing' tab but it shows no data. Am I missing something?

subject: Slow uploads from Europe
body: Uploads from my Frankfurt office to my eu-central-1 bucket are getting about 10 MB/s. We have a gigabit connection. Is this expected or is there something I should configure?
